name: Memo
def: Household robot with two arms on a wheeled base, trained on recordings of people doing chores in real homes, for tidying, dishes and laundry.
facts: Its maker raised $165 million in March 2026 to put the first robots into homes

refs.label: Sunday wants to put a robot in every home, beginning with the launch of Memo, SiliconANGLE
